title: Supplement to the fourth, fifth and sixth editions of the Encyclopaedia Britannica - Volume 3 - EB.12
text: sections; and relate. 1. To the _sancred rites_ the administration of the prescribed ritual; the care of altars, sacrul terraces, and the tombs: unlenses forms of worship; magicalus; leders of sects; and teachers of false doctrines. 2. To miselmannous observances respecting the palaces, the Empony, his equipes, and furniture; to the public festivals and days a ceremony promptant laws, relative to dress and habitations; celestial observations and appearance, regulations for functions and country features.
